blocks.text: SM Hotels & Conventions Corp. (SMHCC), the hospitality arm of SM Prime Holdings Inc., is expanding into the premium leisure tourism market with the development of a new Shangri-La resort in Hamilo Coast, south of Manila. SMHCC is partnering with Shangri-La Group to develop Shangri-La Santelmo Cove, a coastal resort slated to open in 2031. The resort will feature about 40 villas and 50 rooms and suites, set within a protected cove known for its coral reefs, sea turtles and marine biodiversity.
